headline: General Manager · Serial Entrepreneur · AI & Enterprise Transformation Leader
bio: Dynamic innovation leader with a founder's mindset and operator's discipline. Led teams of 50+, raised $2.9M, growth-hacked 450K users in 45 days, and sold enterprise AI (Botbot.ai) to major Vietnamese banks before ChatGPT existed. Now serving as PM & Senior Consultant at Synthesis, leading a full-stack transformation at a leading securities firm — replacing a 12-year-old legacy system, implementing AI-assisted SDLC, Jira-based management transformation, and Vibe Coding for their new core platform. Experienced in ecosystem selling with Microsoft and AWS partners. MBA (Bolton University, UK). DBA candidate (thesis: AI) — graduating 2027.
